items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: And Arvell Shaw played bass. That's five.

ctx.x: Earl was when I met you.

Yeah, but he wasn't -- I'm talking about the first band. Dick Carey played the piano. That's three. I played clarinet. That's four. And Arvell Shaw played bass. That's five. And, let's see, and Velma Middleton was six. She was the vocalist. That's about it, six.
